# eolas

> Python (eolas-data) and R (eolas) clients for the eolas.nz data API

eolas serves cleaned, versioned New Zealand and OECD public data (1,500+ datasets) as JSON, CSV, Arrow or Parquet. The API is read-only. The base URL is https://api.eolas.nz and data routes are under /v1. The API key goes in the X-API-Key header only. Data, change feeds, bulk and /v1/me need a key. Listing, metadata, preview and health need no key. The official clients are eolas-data for Python and eolas for R. Both read the EOLAS_BASE_URL environment variable. The main website is https://eolas.nz, and it has its own summary at https://eolas.nz/llms.txt.


## Start here

- [For coding agents](https://docs.eolas.nz/AGENTS/index.md): Endpoints, query parameters, plan limits, the large-dataset guard, provenance headers and the mistakes that cost a retry. Read this first.
- [Getting started](https://docs.eolas.nz/quickstart/index.md): Install a client and make a first query
- [Authentication](https://docs.eolas.nz/authentication/index.md): API keys and request headers
